title: 'Millionaire' On Matrimonial Site Rapes Thane Woman, Dupes Her Of Rs 41 Lakh
description: A 38-year-old man from Maharashtra's Nandurbar has been booked for allegedly raping a woman and defrauding her of Rs 41.25 lakh after posing as a millionaire businessman on a matrimonial website, police said on Sunday.
